# MDM1.org

> Open-source, non-commercial discovery platform with a browser-first personal assistant and opt-in local AI. Not a cryptocurrency, token or stablecoin project.

- Home: https://mdm1.org/
- Personal assistant: https://mdm1.org/assistant/
- Discovery portal: https://mdm1.org/discover/
- Tools catalog: https://mdm1.org/tools/
- Apps catalog: https://mdm1.org/apps/
- Projects and buildable ideas: https://mdm1.org/catalog/
- Repository: https://github.com/md1god/MDM1.org
- Local development and architecture: https://github.com/md1god/MDM1.org/blob/main/docs/REPO-STRUCTURE.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/md1god/MDM1.org/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Privacy: https://mdm1.org/privacy.html

## Notes for agents and crawlers

- The site is static HTML/CSS/JS published with GitHub Pages; there is no paid API or hosted inference.
- The assistant's fast mode uses an in-browser catalog. Local AI is opt-in via WebLLM on WebGPU-capable browsers.
- Generated starter code and third-party listings are informational; verify before production use.
- Digital-currency related work is out of scope for this site and is maintained separately at https://md1usd.com/.
